title: Finish docs and release readiness

comments.text:
Docs finalized now that the accuracy gate KDATAP-713a0f has passed.

- README 'Sentiment meter' section: exclusions bullet updated to the tuned paste heuristic (>= 4000 chars AND >= 3 [n] citation markers, tuned so genuine long orchestration briefs count); accuracy paragraph now records the gate result (2315 real messages yielded, 2310 counted, 5 verified AI-research pastes excluded, 0 injected false positives).
- Wiki page project/wiki/coding-session-sentiment-meter.md: source table updated with the corpus-pinned semantics (Cursor trailing <user_query> blocks + <timestamp> header parsing + harness follow-up template exclusion; Codex content_item_kinds and AGENTS.md-dump exclusion), privacy section updated, status section records the passed gate with all-time aggregates (2315 messages / 216 sessions, 25 thanks / 127 f-bomb tokens).
- Conventional-commit mapping verified on this branch: the meter is feat(sentiment), corpus-pinned corrections are fix(sentiment), board bookkeeping is chore(kanbus), docs are docs(...) — mapping cleanly onto the semantic-release feat/fix categories.
- Engines note stands: node:sqlite reader requires Node >= 22.5 (README + wiki).
- Verification: full unit suite green (192 suites, 1566 passed, 2 skipped); lint has only the single pre-existing benchmark error (tests/unit/benchmark/packet-validation.spec.ts require() import), unchanged from before this initiative; sentiment coverage ~93-94% lines.

No PR opened; work rides on sentiment-meter-m1 -> origin/cursor/sentiment-meter-impl-5f84 per the initiative's flow.
